tableSchema.notes: Table with a list of all governments in Greenland (Naalakkersuisut) for the time frame covered by the nordatlantisk-ft dataset (starting 2004).

columns.name: cabinet
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Name
columns.description: ID for the cabinet, usually named after the head of government

columns.name: wikidata_id
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Wikidata ID
columns.description: Wikidata Identifier for the entity representing each cabinet

columns.name: location
columns.dc:title: Location
columns.description: Identifier whether this cabinet is from Greenland or the Faroe Islands.
